state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
The robot found the red ball and is now resting about 20–30 cm from it, facing it. In the final camera image the ball is centred just in front of its feet.

How it went:
- The ball wasn't visible from the starting spot. I walked forward, turned left into the open part of the room and spotted it near the TV stand.
- A black case next to the robot kept triggering the collision stop, so I stepped sideways to get around it.
- I then walked toward the ball but went about 2 m and ended up at the TV stand, past it. It was no longer in view, so I turned around and found it right at the robot's feet. A small turn left it facing the ball, and then I called rest.

The robot's heading shifted slightly as it crouched into rest, but the ball still looks centred in front of it.
